common.something_wrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offline: You are offline. On-device models, search and your documents still work; cloud models, web search and downloads need internet.

home.no_provider_hint: Open Model Manager to connect a provider or download an on-device model.
home.no_chats: No conversations yet. Start one with “New chat”.

workspaces.delete_message: This permanently deletes the workspace with its {{chats}} chats and {{docs}} documents from this device.
workspaces.empty_message: A workspace keeps its own chats, documents and instructions together.

documents.empty_hint: Import PDF, Word, PowerPoint, spreadsheet or text files to chat with them.
documents.stage_embedding: Indexing the document on this device…
documents.stage_hint: Large files can take a while. Keep the app open.
documents.delete_message: The document and its index are removed from this device.
documents.cloud_message: With a cloud AI model the document is sent whole together with one conversation, so attach it from the chat’s attachment button. Switch to an on-device model to build an indexed knowledge base here.
documents.missing_hint: Its text is missing, so it cannot be sent to the model. Delete it and import the file again.

agents.subtitle: Tools your assistant can use
agents.assistant_desc: One assistant that decides when to call the tools you switch on below. It cannot use a tool that is off.

models.no_providers: No cloud or server provider is configured yet.
models.no_saved_config: No saved settings for this provider.
models.no_local: No model files found on this device.
models.local_note: Only files actually present in the app’s model folder are listed. Whether a model is loaded is reported by the on-device engine.
models.howto_1: Pick a model that fits your RAM: as a rough rule the file size should be well below your total memory. Smaller models load faster and are less likely to crash.
models.howto_2: Models are downloaded only when you choose to download them. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
models.howto_3: If a model fails to load, the app shows the error. Try a smaller model, close other apps, or lower the context length in the workspace settings.
models.howto_4: Compatibility is not guaranteed by this app: whether a model runs depends on your device and the model file.
models.unloaded: Model unloaded. It loads again with your next message.
models.import_1: Open “Download or remove models” above, choose “Add a model from Hugging Face” and paste a model repo or link, then pick a GGUF file (smaller quantizations such as Q4 run best on phones). Gated or private models are not supported.
models.import_2: Files appear in the list above only after they are on this device. The app never downloads a model unless you confirm the download.

search.privacy: Searches run on this device only.

history.delete_message: This conversation and its messages are deleted from this device.
history.export_empty: This conversation has no messages to export.

profile.no_account: No account — everything is stored on this device.
profile.no_remote: Not connected to a remote server.
profile.theme_dark: Dark (light theme is not available yet)
profile.services_intro: NexVora AI Workspace has no servers of its own. These are the only outside services it can contact, and only as described:
profile.svc_provider_none: On-device model: nothing leaves your phone
profile.svc_web_detail: When you share a link or ask about a URL, the page is fetched from its website.
profile.keys_note: API keys are stored in the Android keystore (keychain) and are never written to logs. Prompts and documents are only sent to the provider you choose.

web_search.title: Web search
web_search.summary: Off until you choose a search provider
web_search.setup_required: Set up web search first (Settings › Web search).
web_search.explainer: Web search is off by default. NexVora AI Workspace has no search server and no shared account. Choose your own provider below; queries go only to it, and only when the assistant decides to search.
web_search.searxng_hint: JSON output must be enabled on your SearXNG instance.
web_search.key_stored: Stored in the Android keystore. Sent as a Bearer token to your server only.
web_search.you_hint: Without a key You.com’s free keyless tier is used and may be rate limited.
web_search.sends_you: Your search queries are sent to api.you.com.
web_search.sends_searxng: Your search queries are sent to the server address above.
web_search.removed: Web search turned off and settings removed
web_search.test_failed: The provider did not answer correctly. Check the address and key.
web_search.then_enable: After saving, switch the Web search tool on in AI Agents or the chat tools menu.
